title: ⌘+L
lede: ⌘+L is a script tag that lets you edit a live website visually, as if it were a design file, then hands each change to a coding agent that opens a pull request.

points: Visual edits are passed in the background to Claude Code, Codex or Letterpress-1, which make the same change in code.
The maker built it because copy tweaks are the most common site change and should not require a terminal.
Supports font size, family, bold and italic, plus margin and padding adjustments.
Adds built-in A/B testing and views of human versus agent traffic to the site.

sections.text: Marketers and site reviewers who want to change copy and spacing without waiting on engineers, while the code change still arrives as a reviewable PR.
